task: Список сотрудников с id и именем, лимит 10
sql: SELECT id, name FROM public.sys_employee WHERE status = 1 LIMIT 10;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM public.acc_number;

task: Найти организации по id и названию, не более 20
sql: SELECT id, name FROM public.org WHERE status = 1 LIMIT 20;
SELECT id, name, create_date FROM public.sys_employee WHERE create_date >= '2020-01-01' LIMIT 50;
SELECT id, account_name FROM public.acc_number WHERE status = 1 LIMIT 100;
SELECT id FROM public.sys_employee WHERE status = 1 LIMIT 100;
SELECT org_id, COUNT(*) AS emp_count FROM public.sys_employee GROUP BY org_id LIMIT 50;
SELECT id, last_modified_date FROM public.acc_number ORDER BY last_modified_date DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT id, name__ru FROM public.sys_employee WHERE name__ru IS NOT NULL LIMIT 25;
SELECT id, name, type_id FROM public.org WHERE type_id IS NOT NULL LIMIT 30;
SELECT id, parent_acc, account_name FROM public.acc_number WHERE parent_acc IS NOT NULL LIMIT 15;
SELECT id, name FROM public.acc_number WHERE is_system = 1 LIMIT 10;
SELECT id, user_id FROM public.sys_employee WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL LIMIT 20;
SELECT MIN(id) AS min_id FROM public.org;
SELECT id, ord FROM public.acc_number WHERE ord > 0 LIMIT 40;
